meaning_en: Material from trees, used for building.
example_en: The table is made of wood.

meaning_en: To do a job.
example_en: I work in an office.

meaning_en: To operate correctly; to function.
example_en: Does this old radio still work?

meaning_en: To work a standard office day.
example_en: I don't want to work nine-to-five forever.

meaning_en: To work at different times of day.
example_en: Nurses often have to work shifts.

meaning_en: A person who works too much.
example_en: My boss is a workaholic; he never stops.
